items.title: 3 US Consumer Staples Stocks Built For Sticky Inflation
items.summary: Inflation is proving sticky, with October PCE running at 3.8% year-on-year and markets bracing for higher rates for longer, so simply hiding in cash may not feel comfortable. Persistent price pressure can reward businesses that keep shoppers coming back while managing their own costs, and punish those that cannot. This article walks through three US consumer staples stocks exposed to this backdrop and explains why each might deserve a closer look now. The stocks covered next are only a sample...
